structural_variants.otherCytogenetics: GATA2/MECOM: 43/200 cells (21.5) had three signals for both probes, consistent with the trisomy 3 observed in the metaphase karyotype. There was no evidence for RUNX1T1/RUNX1 fusion | NUP98:  94/100 cells (94%) had the abnormal 1 red/ 1 green/1 yellow signal pattern, reflecting NUP98 (11p15.4) rearrangement. In one metaphase cell, the green signal appeared to be present on a chromosome 19.  The translocation was not observable in the metaphase karyotype.
